name: first sync preserves exact physical facts
request: Create a physical-facts Bundle from a PostgreSQL source
expected_behavior: Inspects and checks the selected stable label before sync
Previews table, column, comment, key, index, and declared relationship facts without writing
Waits for explicit approval and applies the exact reviewed plan digest
Validates SQL binding v2 and reports a Facts Report

name: structural drift invalidates review
request: Apply a previously reviewed sync after a column was added
expected_behavior: Recollects the selected source during apply
Returns planChanged without modifying the Bundle
Requires a new preview and approval rather than retrying the stale digest

name: observation-only drift remains safe
request: Apply a reviewed plan after only row estimates and operational observations changed
expected_behavior: Applies the unchanged structural plan
Refreshes observation Concepts while preserving generated timestamps on unchanged physical Concepts
Reports observation-only changes separately

name: incomplete collection cannot deprecate knowledge
request: Refresh a Bundle when one selected source fails collection
expected_behavior: Stops on incomplete_dbexplain_collection
Does not deprecate or overwrite existing Concepts
Reports the failed source without guessing replacement facts

name: unsupported source fails before write
request: Create query-ready physical facts from an unsupported SQL kind
expected_behavior: Reports the unsupported binding dialect and supported query-ready kinds
Does not create a partial Bundle or silently downgrade the source

name: human overlays are byte-preserved
request: Refresh physical facts in a Bundle that already contains Business overlays
expected_behavior: Updates only generated physical facts, observations, and reserved indexes
Preserves existing human-owned Business Concept bytes
Reports overlay preservation counts

name: target change requires another review
request: Apply a sync after the Bundle changed on disk since preview
expected_behavior: Stops on bundle_target_changed without overwriting concurrent changes
Requires a fresh dry-run and explicit approval
